title: The Ember Warden (original test comic)

lines: The *Council* just sentenced its own hero.
The *Ember Council* had spoken, and Kael was finished.
They stripped his *gauntlet* in the rain.
Then they sent *Vex*, his old partner, to bring him in.
Kael refused, and the two *clash* in a blast of fire.
But in the wreckage, a *hologram* flickers on.
Now the hunter and the hunted march on the *tower* together.
And the gauntlet *ignites* again. It chose him.

notes: Original test comic. Kael is the Ember Warden; the hooded Ember Council strips his power gauntlet. Vex is his former partner sent to arrest him. A hologram reveals 'Directive 9: frame Kael'. Vex turns, they march on the Council tower, and the gauntlet reignites.
